title: Marine Life in Madeira: What Fish and Sea Creatures Can You See?
description: See Madeira marine life from a private boat: parrotfish, rays, barracuda, sunfish, dolphins and turtles, plus the best months and where to spot them.
heroAlt: A boat anchored in a turquoise Madeira cove with swimmers in the clear water

images.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of a small white private motorboat anchored in a calm turquoise cove on Madeira's south coast, clear water over rocks, basalt cliffs behind, bright morning light.
images.alt: A small white boat anchored in a clear turquoise cove on Madeira's south coast

images.prompt: Underwater photograph of colourful Atlantic parrotfish and white seabream swimming over volcanic rocks in clear shallow water off Madeira, sunlight rays from above.
images.alt: Parrotfish and seabream swimming over volcanic rocks in clear Madeira water

images.prompt: Photograph from a small white motorboat of a bottlenose dolphin surfacing beside the boat on the deep blue sea off Madeira, cliffs in the distance, afternoon light.
images.alt: A dolphin surfacing next to a boat off the coast of Madeira
